{{Top|leg}}
A '''lob bomb''' was a projectile weapon employed by the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. Small enough to mount on a [[BTL-S8 K-wing assault starfighter]], lob bombs fired in ballistic arcs, allowing targets to be hit on the other side of planetary curvatures while not exposing the [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] to enemy fire. The K-wings of the [[24th Bombardment Squadron]] used lob bombs to destroy the [[HVs-2 hypervelocity gun|hypervelocity cannon]] on [[Bessimir]]'s [[alpha moon]].
